**Risk flags:**
- Single shareholder holds 55.65%

**Overview:**  
Gemilang Mega Systems Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited technology firm that develops accounting software for small businesses. It is incorporated on 1994-12-14 and operates in Pulau Pinang, Malaysia. The company has two directors and its largest shareholder owns 55.65% of the equity. The stated share capital is RM 100,000. Reported revenues are RM 205,131,840, RM 221,796,814 and RM 266,012,466 across three undisclosed periods, with equity of RM 112,392,376, RM 104,969,126 and RM 116,734,631 respectively. No legal cases are recorded.
